description: Структура ЛКП Сонячне is a dataset listed in Open data portal of Ukraine (data.gov.ua), a national open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by Львівська міська рада. Автоматичне завантаження наборів відкритих даних Львівської міської ради, харвестинг. Coverage: Львівська міська рада. The publisher named on the listing is Львівська міська рада. Its keywords include Львів, відкриті дані, набори відкритих даних, харвестинг. The listing shows 1 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2018-12-14 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-ua-direct.
